findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed soda nozzles at facility to contain a build up of soils. Discussed with PIC. Ensure soda nozzles are cleaned regularly enough to render them clean to sight and touch. Inspector will return 3/3/25 to re-asses soda nozzle condition.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Multiple pre-packaged foods were observed to be expired or not date marked in two of the open faced coolers on the floor.  Discussed with PIC, items were discarded.  Ensure all items are clearly date marked, and expired items are discarded.

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Residue accumulation was observed on the underside of the coffee pots, above the coffee basket.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure coffee pots and equipment are cleaned regularly.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Areas that need to be re-caulked:
-men’s bathroom sink
-women’s bathroom sink
-mop sink
Ensure these are re-caulked to create a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The hand washing sink was blocked by a dolly upon inspector arrival.  Discussed with PIC, corrected on-site.  Ensure hand sink is accessible at all time.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Residue accumulation was observed on the underside of the coffee pots, above the coffee basket.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure coffee pots and equipment are cleaned regularly.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

Observed no certified food protection manager (CFPM) license available during inspection. PIC stated she has taken the course and exam and is licensed; however, no license was available when requested. Ensure all CFPM’s for the facility have active licenses and copies are left at the facility. Ensure copies are in the public health binder and the binder is updated as needed. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. 

Observed the following places to have equipment that was no longer corrosion-resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth:
1. Microwave near the cheese dispenser (hot holding area) has rust along interior frame. Replace this microwave.
2. The seal around the walk-in cooler door is no longer attached and duct tape is being utilized to keep part of the seal together. Cease practice. Duct tape is not an approved material for food service. Ensure seal of walk-in cooler is repaired before next routine inspection.

Discussed both areas with PIC. Ensure areas are rectified before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

Soda nozzles (2) soiled with mold. Discussed with PIC. They are cleaned nightly, and Pepsi had serviced machines and replaced nozzles last week. Ensure night time staff are removing nozzles and completing wash, rinse, and sanitize of nozzles and scrubbing out inside to prevent soil accumulation. 
Employee removed nozzles during inspection for cleaning.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11  (Pf) Hand washing sink blocked by a step ladder and several mop buckets. Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. Reference 5-205.11.

Observed ladder and mop blocking hand sink at time of inspection. Also observed unopen can of pepsi on handsink. Ensure sink is designated for handwashing only with no extra, obstructing objects placed on it.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) soda nozzles and ice coffee nozzles is not clean to sight and touch. Wash, rinse, sanitize routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A). Ensure nozzles and remaining fixed pieces are washed, rinsed, and sanitized nightly.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114  (P) Sanitizer at 0 ppm. Reference 4-501.114. 

Observed no made sanitizer bucket/bottle. Bleach bottle is empty as well as hydrogen peroxide sanitizer. Ensure facility has methods of sanitization during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text:
7-102.11  (Pf) Working container of hydrogen peroxide not properly labeled. Containers of toxic materials must be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. Reference 7-102.11.

Sanitizer did not have proper EPA label instructions with appropropriate concentration requirements. Ensure all materials intended for food contact surface sanitation have appropriately labeled instructions for use.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14  (Pf) Test kits or other devices are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Provide a test kit or other measuring device so the employees can measure concentrations and ensure proper sanitization. Avoid a concentration of sanitizer that is too high, which can be toxic. Reference 4-302.14.

No test strips available for H2O2 sanitizer, ensure proper sanitizer is used and appropriate test strips available.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed nacho cheese and chili sauce stored in the Gehl's dispenser to be around 113F. All potentially hazardous foods must be stored at 135F and above.
750-150(b)  Hot potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at 135°F or above except during the cooling process. Store hot foods at 135°F or above. (Except for rare roast beef which may be held at 130F.)

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed boxes of live worms stored next to the butter in the reach-in cooler. Properly store food items.
750-130 Ready to eat food shall be stored in a matter to prevent cross-contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the gasket of the walk in cooler to be broken and in disrepair. Replace the gasket.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed a mop bucket filled with soiled waste water in the prep room. Dispose waste water after use.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed debris on the floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Clean the floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT X1 - Observed the ice chute guard in back storage area where facility bags their own ice to be soiled with an accumulation of mold. This guard is cracked and not easily cleanable. Replace guard and wash, rinse, and sanitize this food contact surface regularly to prevent mold growth in this high moisture area. The machine is down and will be replaced soon.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the trash area of the coffee station to be soiled with trash, debris, and coffee spillage. Clean this area regularly.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
REPEAT X1 - Observed coffee filters to be stored on top of coffee machine. Store filters in covered container to prevent possible cross-contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observe leak at faucet of 3 compartment sink. Fix/seal pipe to prevent leak. 
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Restroom ceiling tiles remain acoustic. Replace with smooth and easily cleanable ceiling tiles upon next remodel.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed 1 light bulb in walk in cooler to be burned out and 2 light bulbs in walk in freezer to be burned out. Replace light bulbs.
750-1230(b)(2) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide, at a distance of 30 inches from the floor at least 10 foot-candles of light in walk-in refrigeration, dry storage areas, and in all other areas.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed mop in mop bucket with dirty water in bucket. Worker said the bucket was there when he got to establishment and that he would replace mop water. Mop water remained at end of inspection.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
1) observed boxes of chips and cookies stored on the floor of the back storage area. 2) observed multiple drink containers stored on the floor of the walk in cooler. Store and food and food items at least 6" above the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed two wet wiping cloths stored in two separate cabinets. Store wiping cloths clean and dry or in sanitizer buckets between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice chute guard in back storage area where facility bags their own ice to be soiled with an accumulation of mold. This guard is cracked and not easily cleanable. Replace guard and wash, rinse, and sanitize this food contact surface regularly to prevent mold growth in this high moisture area.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed coffee filters to be stored on top of coffee machine. Store filters in a covered container to prevent possible contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floor of the walk in cooler to be soiled with packaging litter and drink/food splash. Clean this floor.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Restroom ceiling tiles remain acoustic. Replace with smooth and easily cleanable ceiling tiles upon next remodel.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed a wet mop stored in the mop bucket while not in use. Hang mop heads to allow them to properly dry between uses or while in storage.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
